researchFallback.reason: R7-A1-BUILD-IDENTITY-ORACLE is an executable falsifiable delivery artifact and outranks research.
researchFallback.reenableCondition: Only when no dependency-ready implementation, repair, test, certification, build-identity, documentation, packaging, dependency-audit, or release-evidence assignment exists and no conflicting active worker owns the relevant work.
researchFallback.diminishingReturnsRule: Research exhaustion requires a complete six-wake no-novelty round, but the Delivery-Pressure Checkpoint takes precedence whenever a safe executable artifact or verification path exists.
